highlights.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula propõem sobre o funcionalismo público
highlights.summary: Filho do ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro defende enxugar a máquina e fazer cortes em ministérios, enquanto Lula fala de valorização de servidores.

highlights.title: Fire burns down Paris's oldest covered food market
highlights.summary: A fire "completely destroyed" Paris's historic Marché Couvert des Enfants Rouges overnight Monday, authorities said. The cause of the fire that swept through the capital's oldest covered food market remains unknown.

highlights.title: India opposition plans New Delhi protest to demand election chief resign
highlights.summary: Thousands of security personnel have been deployed before a protest rally calling for the election chief's removal.

highlights.title: Nossa Senhora Aparecida: por que a santa envolvida em polêmica eleitoral é a padroeira do Brasil?
highlights.summary: Desde que 12 de outubro foi consagrado a Nossa Senhora, houve muitos questionamentos acerca da lei, por conta de o Estado ser laico e da separação entre Igreja e Estado. Em 2026, a santa se viu envolvida em nova polêmica.

highlights.title: Investigation Into FlyDubai Attacker Puts Spotlight on an Australian Mosque
highlights.summary: Emirati investigators said the co-pilot accused of attacking a captain on a flight to Israel drifted toward extremism during his time as a student in Australia.

highlights.title: Alvarez vs M’billi boxing bout to go ahead in Saudi Arabia despite attacks
highlights.summary: Mexican boxer tells Turki Al-Sheikh he 'fears nothing' and will face M'billi in Riyadh on October 31 'no matter what'.
